notes.title: Patch 1.1.1
notes.content:
Patch v1.1.1 changes:
- fix for potential crash or stall
- fail safes for incorrect campaign/chapter/level ids in save file
- fallbacks in case of corrupted save data
- corrected names for challenge levels, now appear as "Challenges I - Level [number]"
- replaced "Chapter" with "Challenges" in the unlock dialog for the Challenges campaign

notes.title: Content Update 1.1 is here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40216905/72514b4bfe139d109e06164143edae98dff026df.jpg[/img]

Content Update 1.1 brings with it a new levels, new achievements and lots of quality of life improvements. Check out a detailed list of the most important changes below:

• Challenges campaign with 16 new levels
• 13 new achievements
• Extra looks for the ball
• Fewer gems needed to unlock campaigns
• Solving a puzzle will charge the hints bar to the level corresponding to how many gems you just earned
• Quick restart option
• Replay chapter songs from the story book
• Extra move for story levels
• Shorter hints charge times
• Boot-up dialog no longer on by default - it can still be shown by holding Shift when starting the game
• Backspace is now also a keyboard shortcut for Undo
• Other quality of life improvements and minor fixes

I hope you enjoy this update and I thank you for your support!

notes.title: Upcoming update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40216905/c3025e45f2ffd1d81afcc2d5d2da557abb087bff.jpg[/img]

Greetings, puzzle lovers!

I wanted to briefly let you know I'm working on an update for Long Ago: A Puzzle Tale. Upcoming changes include:
• 16 new levels, grouped in a new Challenges campaign
• 13 new achievements
• Extra looks for the ball
• Fewer gems needed to unlock campaigns
• Solving a puzzle will charge the hints bar to the level corresponding to how many gems you just earned
• Quick restart option
• Replay chapter songs from the story book
• Other quality of life improvements and minor fixes

Also, Long Ago: A Puzzle Tale is now on a 20% off sale! So if you haven't downloaded the game yet, now would be a great time to give this charming puzzler a chance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40216905/ec52805065f56695b396e25042005c6dff53488e.png[/img]

You can also get the newly released Made by GrimTalin bundle to get 30% off for both Long Ago: A Puzzle Tale and The Adventures of Elena Temple: Definitive Edition. If you already own one of the titles, enjoy the 30% discount for the other one!

Thank you for your support!
